title: 新同事

lines.text: 小周工作的饭馆来了一位新“同事”：一台送菜机器人。
lines.py: Xiǎo Zhōu gōng zuò de fàn guǎn lái le yí wèi xīn “tóng shì”: yì tái sòng cài jī qì rén.
lines.en: A new "colleague" arrives at the restaurant where Xiao Zhou works: a robot that carries food to the tables.
